150726.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Orange County
150726.note: Times Herald-Record on CrownHeights.info, 3 Jan 2007: 'Having gotten by with various rented spaces and homes since starting up in 2004, the Burstons ...'; CrownHeights.info, 28 May 2006: 'The couple came to Orange County in 2004 to establish what is essentially a Chabad franchise.' Its 'Decade of Dedication' gala was in March 2014.

150727.name: Chabad of Ulster County
150727.note: The Daily Freeman on CrownHeights.info, 2 Mar 2015: Rabbi Yitzchok Hecht 'has served as rabbi at Agudas Achim since 2001'; CrownHeights.info, 14 Mar 2016: Hecht 'came to Agudas Achim in 2001'. Medium: the year he came to Kingston's Congregation Agudas Achim (Chabad of Ulster County's shul); its own site says Chabad has been active in Ulster County since Camp Emunah began in 1953.
